subject: Missed MAP checkpoint — propose new window & plan reprioritization
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Carter <emma@blueskyhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint today — short catch-up?

Emma —

Quick note: we had the 3:30pm MAP checkpoint on the calendar for today and I logged in but it looks like we missed each other. I wanted to check if everything is OK on your side and propose two fallback options for rebooking: tomorrow 10:00–10:30am PT or Tuesday 2:00–2:30pm PT.

Agenda I wanted to cover (15–20 minutes):
- Quick demo of the integration flow (5–7m)
- Prioritized MAP milestones and any shifting internal approvals (7–10m)
- Next steps + owners for the pilot kickoff

I attached an updated draft MAP that reflects our notes from last week — I shaded the items we flagged as potentially at risk. If either timeslot works, I’ll send a new invite immediately. If neither works, tell me a window that does and we’ll accommodate.

Sorry for the scramble — appreciate the quick reply.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: (415) 555-0198

Hi Evelyn —

So sorry — we had an internal escalation that pulled the product and procurement leads into an ad hoc meeting. I feel terrible for the no-show. Tomorrow 10am PT should work for me and I’ll confirm with the procurement lead (copying procurement).

Can you also call out any MAP tasks that would materially change our pilot timeline if they slip? Procurement is sensitive to the go-live date.

Thanks for understanding,
Emma
Director, Product Partnerships
BlueSky Health

Emma / team —

Confirmed for tomorrow 10:00–10:30am PT and I’ve sent calendar invites (see attached .ics). Marcus will cover the demo portion and I’ll walk the MAP changes. Per your ask, I’ve highlighted the three MAP items that would push the pilot start date if delayed:

1) Security review completion (target: Jul 29) — required for provisioning production keys.
2) Data retention sign-off and KMS access (target: Aug 3) — impacts sandbox -> prod validation window.
3) Integration milestone 2 (sample payload validation) — if this slips beyond Aug 10 we should plan the pilot for a staggered rollout.

Proposed mitigation and reprioritization (short):
- Move non-blocking analytics dashboard items to post-pilot (reduce scope).
- Run the security questionnaire in parallel with the demo week — Marcus can hand off the checklist to your security point.

Marcus / Monica — looped you both for visibility and to confirm you’ll be on the call tomorrow. I attached the MAP with the three high-risk rows colored orange.

Thanks,
Evelyn

Attachments: Redwood-demo-invite.ics; MAP_BlueSky_Draft_20270718.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Carter <emma@blueskyhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@blueskyhealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint today — short catch-up?

Emma —

Thanks — I’ll be on the 10:00am PT call and will have a short demo ready that focuses on the sandbox provisioning flow and the KV/cache behavior that we expect to impact the sample payload validation. A couple quick asks to make the session productive:
- If procurement can pre-share any security addenda they require, I’ll have the exact checklist items ready.
- Can you confirm which team will own KMS (internal or third-party) so we can line up compatible onboarding steps?

If we see the security review slipping during the call, my suggestion is to lock the pilot scope now (drop dashboard items) and schedule a follow-up in two weeks specifically for security evidence handoff. That keeps the pilot start date from drifting while the procurement process finishes.

See you at 10.
Marcus Lin
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0122
